sentences.text: Every lighted aid has a characteristic, the pattern that identifies it.
Flashing means the light is dark longer than lit.
Quick means about sixty flashes a minute.
Isophase means equal light and dark.
Occulting means lit longer than dark, with brief eclipses.
Group flashing shows flashes in groups.
Morse A shows a short and a long.

A chart label like F L two, white, ten seconds, forty-five feet, fourteen miles means a white light flashing two at a time every ten seconds, forty-five feet above mean high water, with a nominal range of fourteen nautical miles.
Time the period with a watch to confirm which light you’re looking at.
